score.scope: The complete still's intention, emotional staging, support/contact, hierarchy and material/light coherence insofar as they sustain acting. Fresh whole-picture assessment, not inherited approval from earlier character passes.
score.confidence: High for visible composition, scale behavior and native material differences; moderate for intended micro-gaze interpretation.

deductions.finding: A stronger irregular cellular/crackle pattern crosses materials that should remain distinct: the hero's cream face and green wing, bench wood/metal arm, and workshop timber. At native size it competes with the broad readable forms and makes the unified physical world less convincing than 07.

deductions.finding: The refined builder hand opens low beside its own feet/body rather than unmistakably presenting the toolbox to the stool guests. The resting moth's open oval/head orientation still reads outward more readily than a clear downward glance toward the leaf pair. Proximity establishes relationships better than precise reciprocal attention.

deductions.finding: At 420px, the coder remains readable but leaf contact, the open-eye glance and workshop invitation largely collapse into small clusters. The image retains a warm multi-activity park story, not all of the specified interpersonal beats.
deductions.priority: application limit, not a demand to enlarge guests

criteriaForNine: Restore differentiated, restrained surfaces with 07 as a material-quality control while retaining the verified dark Muse eyes, flat pupil-free Grok eyes and actual leaf contact.
Make the workshop invitation and resting-to-leaf attention read as deliberate relationships at native and 880px scale without changing the tiny anatomy or adding cast/props.
Preserve the successful coder-first composition and readable material/face hierarchy after those corrections; do not award nine solely for satisfying an eye checklist.

strengths: The tree canopy, workshop awning, winding path, softened bridge and foreground bench occupy one continuous park. Overlap, decreasing scale and distant softness give the three appearances a coherent spatial setting.
The broad cream coding face, glasses and silver laptop dominate at 1280, 880 and 420px. The four guests remain in secondary clusters and the foreground belongs to Nag.
Bench/body support, attached stub feet, keyboard mitten, hammer grip, two occupied stools and Muse's leaf-stem contact provide useful physical anchors. No visible pose requires an adult-length limb.
The leaf touch is more explicit than 07. In the supplied enlarged crop Muse has dark eyes and Grok has flat white pupil-free ovals; the previous spot problem is not visible there.
Warm directional light and soft background depth create an inviting environment. Resting, making and coding remain different modes of the same innocent character rather than differently aged figures.

mustFix.action: Recover the cleaner soft-face, wing, wood and metal separation evident in 07; preserve the intentional 11 acting/eye corrections. This is one whole-image finish issue, not an invitation to redesign the scene.
mustFix.acceptance: Native hero/workshop comparison no longer shows the extra crackle pattern or faceted patches overriding material identity; the same improvements survive the full 1280px view.

optional: Clarify the builder's invitation through the existing short mitten and torso/attention relationship; no exaggerated presenter arm.
Clarify the resting moth's attention toward the leaf pair using the existing face/head arrangement, keeping one eye closed and the other graphic.
Accept loss of secondary micro-actions at 420px unless the eventual banner requires those details to communicate essential meaning.
baselineComparison: 07 is visibly cleaner in the hero's soft cream surface, eye/lens treatment, bench and workshop materials. 11 improves Muse-to-leaf contact and opens the builder's free hand, while retaining the scene's overall staging. The invitation is not yet unambiguous, and material degradation offsets the small acting gains. 07 is a control for finish, not a request to discard the corrected eyes or all later work.

workflowChanges: Compare the entire current image with the owner-liked control before inspecting corrected details.
Inspect native material/contact crops and the 5x eye crop separately from reduced composition; improvement on one scale cannot certify another.
Save this independent position before consulting any new whole-scene peer findings. Explicitly separate a must-fix finish issue, optional staging refinements and inherent small-scale limits.
rulesNotApplicableWithReason: No animation is implemented here: UI durations, easing, compositor performance and continuous felt timing are unscored.
Owner-authorized four guests and three same-moth activities supersede older single-prop or two-cameo proposals; assess whether this actual arrangement works.
Pure reference-faithful flatness is not required by the approved dimensional direction. The objection is indiscriminate texture across unlike materials, not dimensional rendering itself.
No browser, editing workflow or additional agents are needed for this supplied-evidence review.
limits: The scales are local resized images, not a tested GitHub layout, mobile device or live publication.
No continuous animation, physics, sound, night treatment or audience recognition/emotional response is scored.
Some far wing panels and contacts are occluded; visible layering does not certify hidden anatomy.
Guest product likeness was not independently audited against the separate external reference set; their stated eye constraints and scene function were inspected.

pairDiscussion.difference: A emphasizes builder invitation and resting-to-leaf attention; B emphasizes coder attention and builder bracing. These remain complementary optional acting observations, not proven anatomical defects or automatic change requests.
pairDiscussion.challengeResponse: Accepted B’s request to keep gesture and attention changes optional. My criteria for nine describe a higher craft target; they do not turn those optional refinements into must-fixes. Clearer gaze must not be bought with pupils, enlarged guests or altered anatomy.
